# Integration fixtures

The shared three-level atmosphere, altitude grid, and three-point HITRAN-style
F11 cross section are generated by fixtures in `tests/conftest.py`. They are
small enough for real RFM, Mie, and DISORT calls while preserving the relevant
scientific interfaces. Native Mie and DISORT cases run through
`tests/_native_cases.py` so their f2py calls cannot terminate pytest itself.
